name: Amorphic Labs
long_description: The next billion software users are AI agents, yet fully autonomous agents remain impossible while every account, bill, and tool still runs through a human. We solve this for both agents and software vendors: vendors use us to let agents sign up and get billed directly, and to improve their agent experience across interfaces like MCP. Agents use us to find, acquire, and pay for what they need, including MCP servers, APIs, datasets, and skills.
